mapping.summary: Calculates and settles commissions for salespeople, teams and external agents.
claims: Rates per item or item group, or per item, customer, salesperson and dimension combination
Tiered commissions by discount given or margin achieved
Tiered commissions against period sales targets

Penalties when invoices are paid late
Pay on invoice posting or only after collection
Settles via settlement documents or purchase invoices
Limited access for salespeople to report on their own data
Reassigns records when a salesperson leaves or changes
Separate Spanish version supports the Cartera module
